label: Test by law determination controls of DNP_inv
note: Probes the cost of the CHANCE_3 rival to DNP_inv when the rival is made quantitative: one symmetry orbit fixes only the uniform law, positive switching fixes a stationary law only relative to a kernel that is itself a quantitative law, and two orbits, zero switching or an idle mixture fix nothing. A non-uniform law therefore needs quantitative input that the rival must supply. Whether such a structure applies to the source is open. It neither supports nor refutes DNP_inv.
